errors_cause_blocked_detail_linux: Look for a CSP violation or an IPC failure in the log tails of this report; for more, run `tail -n 50 ~/.atlas/desktop/stderr.log` (WebKit prints CSP violations and IPC failures there) and read `~/.atlas/desktop/app.log`.
errors_cause_blocked_detail_macos: Look for a CSP violation or an IPC failure in the log tails of this report; for more, run `tail -n 50 ~/.atlas/desktop/app.log`.
errors_cause_blocked_detail_other: Look for a CSP violation or an IPC failure in the log tails of this report; for more, read `desktop/app.log` in the Atlas folder (`~/.atlas`).
errors_cause_blocked_detail_windows: Look for a CSP violation or an IPC failure in the log tails of this report; for more, run `Get-Content $env:USERPROFILE\.atlas\desktop\app.log -Tail 50` in PowerShell.
errors_cause_blocked_title: A request was blocked or the backend did not answer
errors_cause_old_host_detail: The background terminal host (atlas hostd) predates language-server support. Restart it from the status bar; terminals running in it will end.
errors_cause_old_host_title: The terminal host is older than this app
errors_cause_shape_detail: A field the screen reads is missing, typically a name mismatch between the Rust backend (serde) and the frontend.
errors_cause_shape_detail_at: A field the screen reads is missing, typically a name mismatch between the Rust backend (serde) and the frontend. Look at {frame}.
errors_cause_shape_title: The app received data in a shape it did not expect
errors_crash_card_body_crash: A crash report was saved on this machine. Nothing was sent anywhere; report it if you want it looked at.
errors_crash_card_body_hostd_exited: Its terminals ended. Nothing was sent anywhere; report it if it keeps happening.
errors_crash_card_hint_crash: A crash report was saved on this machine. Review the details, then report it if you want it looked at; secrets are removed first.
errors_crash_card_hint_hostd_exited: Its terminals ended. Review the details, then report it if it keeps happening; secrets are removed first.
errors_headline_command_hint: What you asked for did not complete. Atlas is still running. Copy the details or report it if it keeps happening.
errors_headline_error_hint: An error in the window was not handled. Atlas is still running. Copy the details or report it if it keeps happening.
errors_headline_host_hint: Copy the diagnostics (versions, OS, redacted logs) or report it; secrets are removed before anything leaves your machine.
errors_headline_rejection_hint: Something Atlas started on its own did not complete. Atlas is still running. Copy the details or report it if it keeps happening.
errors_panel_ai_note: Each one copies a complete prompt (error, environment, what the app did, stack) and opens an agent with it when a workspace is open. Nothing leaves your machine until you send it.
errors_panel_copy_markdown_hint: The full report, to paste anywhere
errors_panel_explain_hint: Plain language, what to do now; works in any chat AI
errors_panel_file_issue_hint: An agent searches duplicates and opens it with gh
errors_panel_fix_it_hint: An agent reproduces it with a failing test, then fixes the cause
errors_panel_me_too_hint: Copies this report and opens the issue: paste it as a comment.
errors_route_hint: Your terminals and services keep running in the background. Reload to get back to work. If it comes back, use Ask AI to fix it or file an issue with everything already filled in.
errors_route_not_found_hint: Reload to go back to your workspace.
errors_toasts_host_help: Terminals can't start or reconnect until the host is back. Restart it, or report it if this keeps happening.
